modulesGrid.heading: Six signal modules. One verdict
modulesGrid.modules[0].description: A device cannot lie consistently. 1000+ signals catch emulators, root access, app cloning, SIM-swap, tampering, VPN and proxy use before the first action.
modulesGrid.modules[0].title: Device Intelligence
modulesGrid.modules[1].description: It's not what you type, it's how you type it. Rhythm, touch pressure, mouse movement and sensor data — matched to the user's own profile, every session. Bots fail instantly. Account takeovers break within seconds.
modulesGrid.modules[1].title: Behavioural Biometrics
modulesGrid.modules[2].description: A real digital history is hard to fake, and a missing one is a signal in itself. 100+ platforms checked for tenure, depth and breach exposure. Synthetic identities have no real past to stand on. Shruhani sees exactly where it's thin.
modulesGrid.modules[2].title: Digital Footprint
modulesGrid.modules[3].description: Tampered documents, reused identities and spoofed images caught at upload, not at audit. A five-layer pipeline with Face Vault cross-screening every identity already in the system.
modulesGrid.modules[3].title: Image Intelligence
modulesGrid.modules[4].description: Most platforms check if an address exists. Shruhani checks more: does it match the applicant's stated income, does it sit inside a known fraud cluster, and is the borrower actually reachable there. 100m grid resolution, built for India.
modulesGrid.modules[4].title: Location Intelligence
modulesGrid.modules[5].description: Bank-grade inbox categorisation with consent. Salary, EMI, spend and bounces structured for underwriting. The bureau-thin majority, finally readable.
modulesGrid.modules[5].title: SMS Parser
modulesGrid.sub: The foundation beneath all three products. The same six run across ScreenX, Cortex and Escalation — so the signal trail stays consistent from onboarding all the way to investigation.
productShowcase.heading:
Three intelligence suites.
One continuous view of every customer
productShowcase.panels[0].body: Six intelligence modules. 3,000+ attributes per applicant. One real-time decision: safe, review, or decline. Fraud risk, credit risk, and underwriting fit calculated together, not in three separate queues.
productShowcase.panels[0].heading:
Score every new application
before money moves
productShowcase.panels[1].body: Continuous device, behavioural and network signals on every active customer, scored by a dynamic risk engine with 60+ rules. Low risk passes without friction. Medium risk steps up. High risk is blocked — before the first transfer ever clears.
productShowcase.panels[1].heading:
Watch every active account,
every session
productShowcase.panels[2].body: Case files build themselves — full signal trail, linked accounts, external records, all pulled automatically. Law enforcement requests get handled the same way: freeze, lien, debit-freeze, information request, all logged in a full audit trail. Your nodal officer stops working a manual queue.
productShowcase.panels[2].heading:
Work the flag,
end to end
productShowcase.sub: ScreenX decides who comes in. Cortex watches who's already inside. Escalation handles what happens when an account is flagged, by your policy, or by law enforcement.

useCases[0].body: Shruhani scores device, behavioural and identity signals that can't be faked or rehearsed, and flags the fraud before the money moves.
useCases[0].heading: Stay one step ahead of fraudsters
useCases[1].body: Approve genuine customers with confidence and stop the ones hiding behind clean documents. Paperwork proves identity. Shruhani proves intent — so you grow approvals without growing fraud.
useCases[1].heading: See the person, not just the paperwork
useCases[2].body: A thin credit file isn't the same as a risky borrower — it just means the bureau doesn't have enough to go on. Shruhani fills that gap with its own signals, so you can say yes to good borrowers a bureau score alone would leave undecided.
useCases[2].heading: Approve more, without taking on more risk
useCases[3].body: Most compliance work is manual — pulling records, building the case file, preparing the filing. Shruhani's AI agent does that part automatically. Your team spends its time deciding, not assembling, and every step is logged and easy to defend later.
useCases[3].heading: Clear every case faster with a trail you can defend
